capitalist_claim.label: Place a claim
capitalist_claim.what: Puts your claim on a market card. The claimed card works for you as if it were yours: it gives income, counts for synergy and project conditions, and unlocks shady deals. But anyone can still buy it, and it gives no points. You have one claim: a new one moves the old one, and it disappears if you lose the role.

politician_cleanup.label: Settle a scandal
politician_cleanup.what: Removes one of your scandals. Cheaper than normal crisis PR, but it also costs an action.

politician_deal.label: Make a deal
politician_deal.what: Until the end of the round, any district you pick counts as yours: it unlocks that district's projects and shady deals and counts for synergy. You don't need a business there.
politician_deal.cost: 3◆ + 1 scandal, no action, once per turn

politician_veto.label: Veto
politician_veto.what: Closes a project on the board: while the veto stands, only you can take it. The project leaves the board as usual and takes the veto with it. You have one veto, and everyone can see it.

journalist_inflate.label: Blow up a story
journalist_inflate.what: One scandal for a rival and one for you: you get dirty too. If the target has Protection, it stops the hit — and then you get no scandal either.
journalist_inflate.cost: free, no action, once per turn

journalist_publish.label: Publish an exposé
journalist_publish.what: Two scandals for a rival, nothing for you. The target's Protection stops the whole thing.

fraudster_cleanup.label: Cover your tracks
fraudster_cleanup.what: Removes one of your scandals for free.

fraudster_crypto_scam.label: Crypto scam
fraudster_crypto_scam.what: Takes a quarter of every rival's money at once. Protection keeps its owner safe and is used up. It costs five scandals — unless your businesses and projects lower scandals from shady deals, you lose your role.

mafia_racket.label: Racket
mafia_racket.what: Take a cut from one rival: money for your Grey Sector businesses, influence for your Government Quarter businesses. If you have no Government business, you also get a scandal. The target's Protection stops it and is used up.

mafia_cleanup.label: Hush it up
mafia_cleanup.what: Removes two of your scandals at once. You need a Government Quarter business.

mafia_lock.label: Grey hold
mafia_lock.what: A hold on a market card: until the end of the next round, nobody but you can buy it. You have one hold: a new one moves the old one. It is removed by the end of the next round, by the card leaving the market or by a Market Maker re-deal. Everyone can see it.
mafia_lock.cost: 1 Protection, no action, once per turn

military_sanction.label: Sanctions
military_sanction.what: The more scandals the target has, the more they give: with two — money, with three — money and influence, with four — the role too. The target keeps their scandals. Protection stops the sanctions and is used up.

military_inspection.label: Inspection
military_inspection.what: A scandal for every rival who has a Grey Sector business. It hits the district, not one player, so nobody can hide. Protection keeps its owner safe and is used up.

military_roof_seize.label: Take Protection
military_roof_seize.what: Takes one Protection from a rival and gives it to you. Protection does not defend against this.

smear.label: Dirty rumours
smear.note: The only move that hits all rivals at once, so its chance is lower. Each rival's Protection counts separately: it stops their scandal and is used up. One deal can remove three Protections.

crypto.label: Pump and dump
crypto.effect: take up to {{money}}$ from every rival
crypto.note: The money moves to you from other wallets, so it is stronger with more players at the table. Each rival's Protection counts separately: it saves their money and is used up.

roof_break.label: Break Protection
roof_break.effect: remove all the target's Protection, +{{points}} point for each
roof_break.note: The only attack Protection does not stop — it is aimed at Protection itself. Only possible if the target has at least one Protection.

datacenter.label: Hack
datacenter.effect: steal up to {{influence}}◆ from the target
datacenter.note: Influence is the rarest resource, so the chance here is the lowest, and the theft grows every round. The target's Protection is used up and cancels the theft.

influence_broker.label: Leak dirt
influence_broker.note: The target loses the role: −3 points and all role bonuses, and the role can be taken again at the normal price. Only possible if the target has a role. The target's Protection is used up and stops the leak.

defence.title: 🛡 Protection and reputation
defence.roofText: is the only defence in the game. It fully stops any hit on you from a rival: a card, a racket, sanctions, a hack, an attempt to take your role and any scandals. Then it is used up. It does not save you from your own choices (for example, a failed shady deal).
defence.scandalsText: at {{limit}} you lose your role, at {{jail}} you are arrested. You can remove a scandal with crisis PR. If you have no role, one scandal goes away by itself at the start of your turn.

actionsInfo.title: ⚡ Actions
actionsInfo.base: You usually have three actions per turn (the Hustler has four). Unused actions are lost at the end of the turn.
actionsInfo.free: selling a business, playing and discarding cards, and three role powers — it says so on the power itself in “Role powers”.
actionsInfo.once: patronage, lobbying, re-dealing projects, buying cards, one shady deal and some role powers. Playing and discarding cards has no limit.
